## Summary

[Partial] Measure inner tie rod length and check for date codes to verify parts match specifications. [t812]

## Procedure

> **[Partial]** Needs more work: the verifier could confirm only part of this procedure (the steps marked [Partial], or whether the list is complete). Steps or precautions may be wrong or missing; read the source thread before relying on it. Later runs fill it in as more sources are found.

1. Measure the length of the inner tie rod to verify it matches specifications.
2. Check if the received part is stamped with a specific date code (e.g., Q25 or Q26) compared to your original equipment.

## Tools

- [Partial] Tape measure [t812]

## Tips & gotchas

- Be aware that Rock Auto may send longer 'Titan' inners instead of the standard length Xterra/Frontier inners. [t812]
- Verify if the box labeling matches the actual part inside, as inventory mix-ups are common. [t812]
